name: style-air
title: Air
description: The default cool blue Neumorphism UI style with balanced depth and soft controls.

light.neu-shadow-raised-sm: 3px 3px 7px rgb(30 48 72 / 0.14), -3px -3px 7px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.88) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72) 45%, transparent)
light.neu-shadow-inset: inset 2px 2px 7px rgb(30 48 72 / 0.14), inset -2px -2px 7px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.88) 65%, transparent)
light.neu-shadow-primary: 3px 4px 8px rgb(30 48 72 / 0.14), -3px -3px 7px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.88) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #1267f4 86%, white)
light.neu-shadow-primary-hover: 4px 4px 10px rgb(30 48 72 / 0.14), -4px -4px 10px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.88) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #1267f4 86%, white)
light.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #1267f4 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #1267f4 78%, white)
light.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #b92e43 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #b92e43 78%, white)
light.neu-shadow-floating: 0 16px 40px rgb(30 48 72 / 0.14), 0 3px 8px rgb(30 48 72 / 0.14), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.72) 45%, transparent)

dark.neu-shadow-raised-sm: 3px 3px 7px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.34), -3px -3px 7px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.065) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07) 45%, transparent)
dark.neu-shadow-inset: inset 2px 2px 7px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.34), inset -2px -2px 7px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.065) 65%, transparent)
dark.neu-shadow-primary: 3px 4px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.34), -3px -3px 7px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.065) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #5aa2ff 86%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-primary-hover: 4px 4px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.34), -4px -4px 10px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.065) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #5aa2ff 86%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #5aa2ff 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #5aa2ff 78%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #ff7685 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #ff7685 78%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-floating: 0 16px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.34), 0 3px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.34), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07) 45%, transparent)
